opening: I'm excited to apply for the Retrieval Engineer role. As an AI engineer focused on retrieval-augmented generation and search systems, I've spent the past year building production-shaped hybrid retrieval pipelines -- combining BM25, dense vector search, reciprocal rank fusion, and cross-encoder reranking -- while also shipping applied ML systems in data engineering and course-recommendation. I'd welcome the chance to bring that retrieval-systems background to your team.

experience_paragraphs.experience_1: At Example Research Lab, I built a data pipeline that merged 5 heterogeneous lab datasets, trained a baseline classifier that improved validation F1 from 0.71 to 0.84, and wrote automated tests that eliminated a recurring weekly pipeline regression. This work sharpened my instincts for reliable, well-evaluated systems.
experience_paragraphs.experience_2: At Example Data Systems, I automated a manual data-labeling step that cut turnaround time from 2 days to 4 hours, and integrated a vector database into an internal search prototype with evaluation scripts the team still relies on. That experience deepened my comfort tuning production pipelines for both speed and quality -- skills directly transferable to tuning retrieval latency and result quality at scale.

project_paragraph: My Project Meridian work directly mirrors this role's core responsibilities: hybrid BM25 plus HNSW vector retrieval fused with reciprocal rank fusion, cross-encoder reranking, and a LangGraph retrieve-grade-retry loop over a 40k-article internal support-documentation corpus. I built a quantitative evaluation harness -- Recall@k, nDCG@k, MRR, and LLM-judged faithfulness -- that gated a cost/latency optimization pass, cutting cost 24% and latency 33% while keeping Recall@10 within two points of baseline.
closing: I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my retrieval-systems experience -- spanning hybrid search, evaluation harnesses, and production deployment -- can contribute to your team's search infrastructure. Thank you for considering my application; I'm happy to share code, evaluation results, or further detail on any of the projects above, and I look forward to speaking with you soon.
